subject: Play Store Pulse 01-11 to 13-11: support tops complaints, check 20.0.0
bottom_line: Ratings held at [[kpis.avg_rating#0|dec2]], customer support is still the top complaint, and release 20.0.0 runs at [[versions.one_star_share@version=20.0.0|pct]] 1-star.
